LanguageData.NRB_PhysicsReplaced: Node Research: Branches arranges the research tree from left to right, so physics and these force sliders have no effect.
LanguageData.NRB_MaxFanRowsDesc: When one project leads to more end-of-branch projects than this, they wrap into extra columns instead of one tall stack. Lower values make the tree shorter and wider.
LanguageData.NRB_EraAspectDesc: Separate trees within an era are wrapped into side-by-side stacks until the era is about this tall compared with its width. Lower values make each era flatter and wider.
LanguageData.NRB_HideCrossEraLines: Only show lines between eras for the selected bubble
LanguageData.NRB_HideCrossEraLinesDesc: In the All view, lines from one era to another are drawn only when you select a bubble at either end.
LanguageData.NRB_HideExtraLines: Only show extra prerequisite lines for the selected bubble
LanguageData.NRB_HideExtraLinesDesc: Each project keeps the line to the branch it grows from. Lines to its other prerequisites are drawn only when you select a bubble at either end.
